DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

PROCEDURE insert_attribute_details

 FiCompanyNo IN varchar2,
 OrderNo IN varchar2,

 UnitID IN varchar2,
 ProductCode IN varchar2,
 Aliquot IN varchar2,
 BloodType IN varchar2,
 FiPriceSchNo IN varchar2,
 InsertDate IN varchar2,
 OrderQty IN number,
 ShipQty IN number,
 TranType IN varchar2,
 RetAdvice IN varchar2,
 Flag OUT varchar2) is
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct v.service_code, v.credit_flag,
 p.price, p.attrib_group, v.attrib_desc
 from vserv_attributes v, pick_slip_product_attr p
 where v.attrib_group = p.attrib_group
 and v.attrib_code = p.attrib_code
 and unit_id = UnitId
 and product_code = ProductCode
 and aliquot = Aliquot
 and exists (select 'x'
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps
 where psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = p.pick_slip_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and ps.order_no=:order_no
 and psp.unit_id = :unit_id
 and psp.product_code = :product_code
 and psp.aliquot = :aliquot)
 order by 1;
 auto_cnt number;
 out_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp1 VARCHAR2(24);
 temp2 VARCHAR2(60);
 price_no varchar2(2);
 patient_name varchar2(24);
 temp_shipdate date;
 temp_insertdate date;
begin
 temp_shipdate := to_rrdate(shipdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 temp_insertdate := to_rrdate(insertdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI:SS');
 auto_cnt := 0;
 select count(*) into auto_cnt
 from pick_slip_product_attr
 where unit_id = UnitId
 and product_code = ProductCode
 and aliquot = Aliquot
 and attrib_group = 'DON'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 Flag := 'Y';
 patient_name := :s_patient_name;
 price_no := '00';
 if type = 'S' then
 for c1rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 temp1:=substr(ProductCode||'-'||Aliquot||' '||
 BloodType,1,24);
 temp2:=substr(UnitId||' '||c1rec.attrib_desc,1,60);
 if c1rec.credit_flag = 'N' then
 goto end_loop_1;
 end if;
 if auto_cnt > 0 then
 if c1rec.attrib_group != 'DON' then 
 goto end_loop_1;

 billing_interface.insert_invoice_details
 ( FiCompanyNo,
 OrderNo,
 ArAccount,
 c1rec.service_code,
 temp_ShipDate,
 c1rec.price,
 temp_InsertDate,
 patient_name,

 FiPriceSchNo,
 price_no,
 OrderQty,
 ShipQty ,
 TranType,
 RetAdvice,
 out_flag);
 end if;
 else
 billing_interface.insert_invoice_details
 ( FiCompanyNo,
 OrderNo,
 ArAccount,
 c1rec.service_code,
 temp_ShipDate,
 c1rec.price,
 temp_InsertDate,
 patient_name,
 temp1, temp2,
 FiPriceSchNo,
 price_no,
 OrderQty,
 ShipQty ,
 TranType,
 RetAdvice,
 out_flag);
 end if;
 <<end_loop_1>>
 null;
 end;
 end loop;
 else
 if type = 'R' then
 for c1rec in c1
 loop
 temp1:=substr(ProductCode||'-'||Aliquot||' '|| BloodType,1,24);
 temp2:=substr(UnitId||' '||c1rec.attrib_desc,1,60);
 if c1rec.credit_flag = 'N' then 
 goto end_loop_2;
 else
 billing_interface.insert_invoice_details
 ( FiCompanyNo,
 OrderNo,
 ArAccount,
 c1rec.service_code,
 temp_ShipDate,
 c1rec.price,
 temp_InsertDate,
 patient_name,
 temp1, temp2,
 FiPriceSchNo,
 price_no,

 end if;

FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;
